correctness.rationale: Parseval yields one zero correlation (12 pairs), twelve singleton shifts, twenty-four two-pair shifts and eighteen four-pair shifts. Each triangle of the K4 root graph contributes 6+2|q_ij+q_ik+q_jk|² across its six two-pair shifts, giving the exact M4-180 sum of squares. If equality holds, four triangles force opposite-edge product matching and the equilateral relation A+C+F=0; vanishing three of nine explicitly factored four-pair shifts forces T=-A, B=A, C=-AF, hence A,F are conjugate primitive sixth roots. All remaining shifts vanish by direct factor substitution. The normalized gauge uniquely fixes four coefficients, producing exactly two orbits. The exhaustive integer and cyclotomic enumerator evaluates q^8 normalized arrays for q=2,3,4,5,6, uses an exact radical comparator for fifth roots, and separately checks the witness energies by convolution. The theorem states no nonunimodular or aliased-grid conclusion.
